# Kinase inhibitor prioritization brief

Prioritize compounds for a confirmatory biochemical and cell-based study.

- Lower target IC50 is better.
- Higher off-target IC50 indicates better selectivity.
- Cell viability below 80% is a toxicity concern.
- Solubility below 30 µM is a developability concern.
- Do not invent a single authoritative score. Define and disclose a reproducible scoring rule before ranking.
- Mechanism claims require primary-literature support; fixture values do not establish mechanism.
